newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Cowen to up Compaq EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Cowen to up Compaq EPS view.

text.p: -- Cowen & Co analyst Richard Chu said he expected to raise his 1997 earnings estimate for Compaq Computer Corp's 1997 year to somewhere in the range of $5.90 to $6.00 per share from his prior $5.60 estimate.
-- Chu said the new numbers were preliminary and that he would make a final call later in the day.

-- The analyst's optimism on earnings followed the company's statement in its fourth quarter earnings report released earlier Wednesday that it expected strong growth in 1997, market share gains and increased profits.
